plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and repeat donors

panels.title: Monthly Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT("Date", "%Y-%m") AS month, SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top Cities by Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT City, SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Modes Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Repeat Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS n FROM donor_transactions WHERE Donor IN (SELECT Donor FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a comprehensive view of donation activity. The monthly trend panel ({{p1}}) visualizes the total donation amount over time, highlighting seasonal patterns. The top cities panel ({{p2}}) identifies the most significant contributors geographically, while the payment modes panel ({{p3}}) shows the distribution of transaction types, aiding in resource allocation for payment infrastructure. Finally, the repeat donors KPI ({{p4}}) quantifies the number of donors who have contributed multiple times, indicating loyalty and potential for sustained engagement.
